recommendedModules.menuHint: The following modules enhance Eskie Macro Pack by supplying visual assets, audio effects, animations, or advanced automation.

foundryRegions.name: Foundry V14+ Scene Regions
foundryRegions.description: Natively triggers EMP trap macros, zone animations, and interactive scene events via Region Behaviors without requiring third-party modules.

eskieEffects.name: Eskie Effects (Patreon or Free)
eskieEffects.description: Custom visual assets, textures, token masks, and sound effects designed specifically for Eskie Macro Pack animations.

jb2a.name: JB2A - Animated Assets (Patreon or Free)
jb2a.description: Essential collection of high-quality spell, attack, ambient, and template animations used by EMP macros and Automated Animations presets.

jaamod.name: Jinker's Animated Art
jaamod.description: Free animated graphics and template animations for spell, attack, and scene visual effects.

bossLoot.name: Boss Loot Assets (Patreon or Free)
bossLoot.description: High-resolution impact textures, spell graphics, particle overlays, and audio tracks for EMP traps and cinematic effects.

psfx.name: PSFX - Peri's Sound Effects
psfx.description: Rich audio sound effect libraries integrated into EMP macro sound presets.

matt.name: Monk's Active Tile Triggers (MATT)
matt.description: Allows scene tiles to trigger EMP trap macros, falling hazards, and interactive map events when tokens enter or interact.

tagger.name: Tagger
tagger.description: Enables tag-based selection for tokens, tiles, and drawings. Used by EMP for automated trap triggers, zone detection, and targeted macro effects.

tokenAttacher.name: Token Attacher
tokenAttacher.description: Attaches tiles, lights, sounds, and drawings to tokens for complex animated macro setups.

massEdit.name: Baileywiki Mass Edit
massEdit.description: Enables linking and attaching elements to canvas tiles and tokens for advanced scene object manipulation.

foundrySummons.name: Foundry Summons
foundrySummons.description: Enables automated creature, spirit, and token summoning directly onto scene canvases for EMP summoning macros.

autoanimations.name: Automated Animations
autoanimations.description: Automatically triggers EMP spell and item animations when actions, rolls, or attacks are performed in supported game systems.

bossLootFx.name: BLFX Animation Editor Premium
bossLootFx.description: Automatically triggers EMP spell and attack animations in Foundry v14+ using Boss Loot FX Custom Auto-Recognition.

worldScripts.menuHint: World scripts are modular features that run automatically for each player on load. Configure which features you want active in this world below.

rollAnimation.name: Eskie d20 Roll Animations
rollAnimation.hint: Plays a custom Eskie d20 roll animation sequence just above a token on saving throws and ability checks.

ask.name: Prompt on Startup
ask.description: Prompt to choose whenever new animation presets are detected on load.

setup.chooseTrapContent: Choose a trap to configure and set up on the canvas.
setup.customEffectPrompt: Enter the spell or animation effect path (e.g. fireball, lightningBolt, disintegrate):
setup.customEffectDisclaimer: Note: Not all effects have been tested as traps.
setup.noTrapChosen: No trap chosen. Trap setup cancelled.
setup.noSetupMethod: Trap "{name}" has no setup configuration method.
setup.onlyGm: Only a GM can setup traps.
setup.step1Content:
Select the **Trigger Tile(s)** on the canvas (which tokens step on to trigger the trap).

Click Continue once selected.
setup.noTriggerTiles: No trigger tiles selected. Trap setup cancelled.
setup.step2OriginContent:
Select the **Trap Origin Tile(s)** on the canvas (where the trap starts or shoots from).

Click Continue once selected.
setup.noOriginTiles: No trap origin tiles selected. Trap setup cancelled.
setup.step3TargetContent:
Select the **Trap Target Tile** on the canvas (where the trap shoots towards or lands).

Click Continue once selected.
setup.noTargetTiles: No trap target tiles selected. Defaulting to use Trigger Tiles.
setup.step2AnimContent:
Select the **Trap Animation Tile(s)** where the visual effect will play.

Click Continue once selected.
setup.noAnimTiles: No trap animation tiles selected. Defaulting to use Trigger Tiles.
setup.modeDialogContent: Select how you want this trap to be triggered on the canvas:
setup.step1RegionContent:
Select the Trigger Region(s) on the canvas (which tokens enter to trigger the trap).

Click Continue once selected.
setup.noTriggerRegions: No trigger regions selected. Trap setup cancelled.
setup.step2OriginRegionContent:
Select the Trap Origin Tile(s) or Region(s) on the canvas (where the trap starts or shoots from).

Click Continue once selected.
setup.step3TargetRegionContent:
Select the Trap Target Tile or Region on the canvas (where the trap shoots towards or lands).

Click Continue once selected.
setup.step2AnimRegionContent:
Select the Trap Animation Tile(s) or Region(s) where the visual effect will play.

Click Continue once selected.

projectile.chooseTypeContent: Choose the projectile type for this trap.
projectile.noTypeChosen: No projectile type chosen. Setup cancelled.
projectile.step2Content:
Select the Projectile Origin Tile or Region (arrow slit, pipe, or wall launcher where missiles fire from).

💡 Can be a Region or Tile.

Click Continue once selected.
projectile.step3Title: Trap Setup - Projectile: Step 3 (Target / Impact Area)
projectile.step3Content:
Select the Target Tile or Region (where missiles land or aim towards).

💡 Can be a Region or Tile.

Click Continue once selected.

rollingBoulder.noEndTile: Rolling Boulder Trap: Tile "{id}" has no configured end tile.
rollingBoulder.step2Title: Trap Setup - Rolling Boulder: Step 2 (Boulder Spawn Point)
rollingBoulder.step2Content:
Select the Boulder Origin Tile or Region (where the boulder spawns and begins rolling).

💡 Can be a Region or Tile.

Click Continue once selected.
rollingBoulder.step3Title: Trap Setup - Rolling Boulder: Step 3 (Crash / Destination Point)
rollingBoulder.step3Content:
Select the Target Tile or Region (where the boulder rolls towards and crashes).

💡 Can be a Region or Tile.

Click Continue once selected.

bullRushStatue.step2Title: Trap Setup - Bull Rush Statue: Step 2 (Statue Tile)
bullRushStatue.step2Content:
Select the Statue Tile on the canvas (the physical statue that will charge across the room).

⚠️ A Tile is required to provide the statue image.

Click Continue once selected.
bullRushStatue.noTile: Bull Rush Statue requires a Tile placeable on the canvas for the statue graphic. Trap setup cancelled.
bullRushStatue.step3Title: Trap Setup - Bull Rush Statue: Step 3 (Target / Destination)
bullRushStatue.step3Content:
Select the Target Tile or Region on the canvas where the statue will charge towards.

Click Continue once selected.

floodingRoom.step2Title: Trap Setup - Flooding Room: Step 2 (Water Floor Tile)
floodingRoom.step2Content:
Select the Water Floor Tile on the canvas (the tile covering the floor that will flood the room).

⚠️ A Tile is required for the water graphic to fade in and tint blue.

Click Continue once selected.
floodingRoom.noTile: Flooding Room requires a Tile placeable on the canvas for the water graphic. Trap setup cancelled.

pitfall.step2Title: Trap Setup - Pitfall: Step 2 (Pit Hole Tile - Optional)
pitfall.step2Content:
Select the Pit Hole Tile (Optional) on the canvas if you have a hidden pit graphic to reveal when triggered.

💡 If you do not have a pit tile, simply click Continue with your Trigger Region selected to use pure animation.

fallingSky.step2Title: Trap Setup - Falling from the Sky: Step 2 (Crater Tile - Optional)
fallingSky.step2Content:
Select the Crater / Landing Tile (Optional) on the canvas if you have a crater decal to reveal on impact.

💡 If you do not have a crater tile, leave your Trigger Region selected and click Continue.

spike.step2Content:
Select the Spike Zone where spikes will emerge.

💡 No tiles required. Leave your Trigger Region selected to play spikes over the trigger area.

fallingRocks.step2Content:
Select the Rock Fall Zone where rocks fall from the ceiling.

💡 No tiles required. Leave your Trigger Region selected to drop rocks over the trigger area.

electricDoor.step1Title: Trap Setup - Electric Door: Doorway Region
electricDoor.step1Content:
Select the Doorway Region on the canvas (covering the door opening). Tokens entering this region will trigger the electric trap.

💡 No tiles required.

Click Continue once selected.

fire.step2Title: Trap Setup - Fire: Step 2 (Flame Nozzle / Origin)
fire.step2Content:
Select the Fire Origin Tile or Region (wall nozzle or grate where flames shoot from).

💡 Can be a Region or Tile.

Click Continue once selected.
fire.step3Title: Trap Setup - Fire: Step 3 (Flame Target / Direction)
fire.step3Content:
Select the Target Tile or Region (where the flame cone shoots towards).

💡 Can be a Region or Tile.

Click Continue once selected.
